sentence: Of the \num{\res{mdea-searches-attempted-transfer}} searches of the provisional MDEA model, \num{\res{mdea-searches-available-transfer}} finished and \res{mdea-searches-unavailable-transfer} did not: \res{mdea-grid-searches-unavailable-transfer} at grid states and \res{mdea-measurement-derived-searches-unavailable-transfer-summary} at measured states.
interpretation: The sentence uses the available-optimization count as a completion count. Report optimization availability and completion separately.

sentence: Of the \res{mdea-searches-unavailable-supplement} searches that did not finish, \res{mdea-grid-searches-unavailable-supplement} are at grid states, \res{mdea-grid-searches-unavailable-lower-pressure} at 1.05 and \res{mdea-grid-searches-unavailable-upper-pressure} at 3.0 times the bubble pressure, and \res{mdea-measurement-derived-searches-unavailable-supplement-summary} at measured states, so \res{mdea-measurement-derived-searches-unavailable-supplement-availability} of the \res{mdea-measurement-derived-searches-attempted-supplement-availability} searches at measured states give no stability result.
interpretation: The sentence uses the available-optimization count as a completion count. Report optimization availability and completion separately.
The table note uses available optimizations as completed searches.

sentence: The searches that finish detect a descent \res{mdea-descents-all-transfer-search} times, at no grid state; the \res{mdea-descents-all-transfer-detections} detections fall at \res{mdea-distinct-descent-states-transfer} distinct states of measured composition, \res{mdea-descent-states-at-measured-pressure-transfer-detection} searched at their measured pressures and \res{mdea-assigned-pressure-distinct-descents-transfer} at pressures assigned to the state rather than measured.
interpretation: The two sentences attribute all 80 detections to finished searches. Keep the optimized and supplied-trial populations separate on W.

sentence: The \num{\res{mdea-searches-available-supplement}} searches that finish detect a descent \res{mdea-descents-all-supplement} times, at \res{mdea-distinct-descent-states-supplement-total} distinct measured states and at no grid state.
interpretation: The two sentences attribute all 80 detections to finished searches. Keep the optimized and supplied-trial populations separate on W.

sentence: At \res{mdea-bubbles-above-measured-apart-from-zheng-two} of the \res{mdea-descent-states-at-measured-pressure-transfer-bubble} measured-pressure states, rows 1 and 3--5 of the heats of Zheng et al.\ \cite{zhengCO2HeatAbsorption2020} and the \res{mdea-sobrino-bubble-comparison-count-transfer} \COtwo-free densities of Sobrino et al.\ \cite{sobrinoViscosityDensityMeasurements2016} at \SI{393.15}{\kelvin}, the bubble pressure of the MDEA model lies above the measured pressure, for example \res{mdea-zheng-row-5-bubble-pressure-transfer} against \SI{2.57}{\mega\pascal} at Zheng row 5 and \res{mdea-sobrino-example-bubble-pressure-transfer} against \SI{0.100}{\mega\pascal} for Sobrino (Table~\ref{supp-tab:supplement-mdea-phase-outcomes}).
interpretation: The eight-case cohort excludes Zheng row 2 as a near-coincidence. Its returned pressure also strictly exceeds the measured pressure. The Sobrino example is the fit:218:problem feed.

sentence: At Zheng row 2 the two pressures nearly coincide, \res{mdea-zheng-row-2-bubble-pressure-transfer} against \SI{1.190}{\mega\pascal}, and at Zheng row 6, \SI{4.19}{\mega\pascal}, the bubble calculation was refused as infeasible, so that state is unevaluated.

evidence.bubble_diagnostic: infeasible: residual 0.10049094498760756 against EQUILIBRIUM_ROW_RESIDUAL 1e-10 after 132 iterations, contraction absent, floor 4.492187005086163e-09, amplification 0

interpretation: The absent comparison is the bubble-pressure result. The phase search at this feed records a descent.

sentence: It is not shown to be free of splits, because \res{mdea-measurement-derived-searches-unavailable-transfer-limitation} of its \res{mdea-measurement-derived-searches-attempted-transfer} searches at measured states give no result (Section~\ref{supp-sec:s-phase}), which also reports targeted controls far above the measured pressures.
interpretation: Supplied-trial evidence establishes a calculated descent in some cases where the optimized result is unavailable.

sentence: Finite searches do not prove global phase stability, and the MDEA searches leave \res{mdea-all-searches-unevaluated-percent-discussion}\,\% of their states undecided, and \res{mdea-measured-searches-unevaluated-percent-discussion}\,\% of those at measured states.
interpretation: The percentages count unavailable optimizations. They are not counts of physically undecided phase states.

sentence: These pressures are more than \res{mdea-targeted-pressure-native-search-ratio} times the highest pressure of any search at a measured state, \res{mdea-maximum-native-measured-search-pressure} MPa, the calculated bubble pressure at row 13 of Table~6 of Ermatchkov et al.; no measurement tests the phase behavior there.
interpretation: The 14.46 MPa maximum and the more-than-14 ratio apply to native searches. Supplied trials reached a higher pressure at the same feed.

sentence: For MEA, DEA and AMP linearized descent steps from the endpoints, replayed independently, change the objective by less than $10^{-10}$ of its value, consistent with that tolerance; for MDEA the shortest such step lowers it by $\res{mdea-shortest-tested-projected-step-relative-cost-decrease-methods}$ of its value, more than the tolerance, so the MDEA endpoint is also not converged to that tolerance.
interpretation: The tested full AMP free-slope step increased the objective by more than 1e-10 relative. The largest observed decrease remains below that magnitude.

sentence: For MEA, DEA and both AMP fits the optimizer stopped on its relative function tolerance, and linearized descent steps from each endpoint, replayed independently, change the objective by at most $10^{-10}$ of its value, consistent with that tolerance.
interpretation: The tested full AMP free-slope step increased the objective by more than 1e-10 relative. The largest observed decrease remains below that magnitude.

sentence: The states are one fitted bubble state of each amine, the Hilliard MEA \COtwo partial pressure at \SI{\res{mea-gibbs-derivative-state-temperature}}{\kelvin} and \SI{\res{mea-gibbs-derivative-bubble-pressure-supplement}}{\kilo\pascal}, the Lal et al.\ DEA pressure at \SI{\res{dea-gibbs-derivative-state-temperature}}{\kelvin} and \SI{\res{dea-gibbs-derivative-bubble-pressure-supplement}}{\kilo\pascal}, the Hartono et al.\ AMP pressure at \SI{\res{amp-gibbs-derivative-state-temperature}}{\kelvin} and \SI{\res{amp-gibbs-derivative-bubble-pressure-supplement}}{\kilo\pascal} and a Kuranov et al.\ MDEA pressure at \SI{\res{mdea-gibbs-derivative-state-temperature}}{\kelvin} and \SI{\res{mdea-gibbs-derivative-bubble-pressure-supplement}}{\mega\pascal}, and the MDEA feed at \SI{\res{mdea-parent-gibbs-derivative-state-temperature}}{\kelvin} and \SI{\res{mdea-derivative-control-pressure-inventory}}{\mega\pascal}, as one liquid and as the two liquid inventories of the split of the fit with the references at the system pressure.
key: derivative rows[selected-MEA,selected-DEA].pressure_Pa; corresponding total and partial pressure row identities
interpretation: The 6.675 and 7.130 kPa values are calculated total bubble pressures; the pressure observable of the Hilliard and Lal inputs is the CO2 partial pressure.
